mapper.select:
SELECT r.report_id AS reportId, r.reporter_user_id AS reporterUserId, reporter.login_id AS reporterLoginId,
r.target_type AS targetType, r.target_id AS targetId, r.target_user_id AS targetUserId,
target_user.login_id AS targetLoginId, target_user.nickname AS targetNickname,
r.target_field AS targetField, r.reason_id AS reasonId, reason.reason_name AS reasonName,
r.detail AS detail, r.status AS status, r.action_type AS actionType,
r.processed_by_user_id AS processedByUserId, r.processed_at AS processedAt, r.created_at AS createdAt, r.updated_at AS updatedAt,
CASE
WHEN r.target_type = 'ITINERARY' THEN ( SELECT i.title FROM tb_itinerary i WHERE i.itinerary_id = r.target_id )
WHEN r.target_type = 'TIP' THEN ( SELECT t.title FROM tb_tip t WHERE t.tip_id = r.target_id )
WHEN r.target_type = 'MATE' THEN ( SELECT m.title FROM tb_mate m WHERE m.mate_id = r.target_id )
WHEN r.target_type = 'TIP_COMMENT' THEN ( SELECT t.title FROM tb_tip_comment c INNER JOIN tb_tip t ON t.tip_id = c.tip_id WHERE c.comment_id = r.target_id )
WHEN r.target_type = 'MATE_COMMENT' THEN ( SELECT m.title FROM tb_mate_comment c INNER JOIN tb_mate m ON m.mate_id = c.mate_id WHERE c.comment_id = r.target_id )
WHEN r.target_type = 'ITINERARY_COMMENT' THEN ( SELECT i.title FROM tb_itinerary_comment c INNER JOIN tb_itinerary i ON i.itinerary_id = c.itinerary_id WHERE c.comment_id = r.target_id )
WHEN r.target_type = 'USER' THEN COALESCE( target_user.nickname, target_user.login_id )
ELSE CONCAT( '신고 대상 #', r.target_id )
END AS targetTitle,
CASE
WHEN r.target_type = 'TIP_COMMENT' THEN COALESCE( ( SELECT c.tip_id FROM tb_tip_comment c WHERE c.comment_id = r.target_id ), 0 )
WHEN r.target_type = 'MATE_COMMENT' THEN COALESCE( ( SELECT c.mate_id FROM tb_mate_comment c WHERE c.comment_id = r.target_id ), 0 )
WHEN r.target_type = 'ITINERARY_COMMENT' THEN COALESCE( ( SELECT c.itinerary_id FROM tb_itinerary_comment c WHERE c.comment_id = r.target_id ), 0 )
WHEN r.target_type = 'USER' THEN COALESCE( r.target_user_id, r.target_id )
ELSE r.target_id
END AS viewTargetId
FROM tb_report r
LEFT JOIN tb_report_reason reason ON reason.reason_id = r.reason_id
LEFT JOIN tb_user reporter ON reporter.user_id = r.reporter_user_id
LEFT JOIN tb_user target_user ON target_user.user_id = r.target_user_id
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
